Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, classrooms, specialized spaces, and site plans; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; integrates condition data with student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Chunks 1, 26, 35).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10+ years using cohort survival method; includes demographic, housing, and permit data; detailed capacity utilization by site and grade; connects projections to facility actions and adaptive space uses (Chunks 2-6, 26, 30, 35, 38).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle; detailed educational specifications for K-8 and 9-12 with clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; comprehensive analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including STEM, CTE, special education, and technology-rich environments (Chunks 6-17, 26, 30, 35, 38, 41, 44, 46).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces such as playfields, athletic fields, and plazas; identifies strategies for improvement like adding multipurpose rooms and gymnasiums; mentions outdoor learning and wellness but lacks districtwide greening data or climate resilience framing (Chunks 26, 27, 35, 36).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related facility issues such as stormwater management and HVAC ventilation improvements; includes some MEPC upgrades addressing environmental controls; however, lacks comprehensive districtwide climate risk assessment or integrated climate resilience strategies (Chunks 19, 20, 21, 35).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Plan includes MEPC assessments with recommendations for HVAC, electrical, and plumbing upgrades; discusses energy-related repairs and improvements; references energy resilience goals but does not present comprehensive electrification or decarbonization strategies (Chunks 19, 20, 35, 44).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed capital strategy with itemized cost estimates, prioritization of projects, and multiple funding strategies including Measure E; includes lifecycle cost considerations and phased project schedules; aligns financial capacity with educational and facility priorities (Chunks 20-25, 26, 30, 33, 38, 43).
